name: FKIE Multimaster Core Logic Migration
description: Migrate the core monitoring and synchronization logic of the FKIE Multimaster stack. Focuses on XML-RPC Master API handling, loop prevention, and batched topic registration.

required_artifacts.master_monitor.py: Handles local ROS Master state retrieval and mapping.
required_artifacts.sync_thread.py: Executes remote-to-local topic and service synchronization.
required_artifacts.MasterState.msg: Defines the communication contract between masters.
